operators.name: max_dim1
semantics: Reduces over dimension 1 (size 10), keeping dimensions 0,2,3 unchanged.
Output shape [512,256,256], dtype float32, CUDA tensor.
For each index (b,h,w), output[b,h,w] = max_{c=0..9} x[b,c,h,w].
Max values are copied exactly, no extra transformations.

operators.name: log1p
semantics: Output shape same as input [512,256,256], dtype float32, CUDA tensor.
For each element y = log(1 + x).
Handles positive and negative x according to standard log1p definition.
Output shape [512,256,256], dtype float32, CUDA tensor.
Values are maximum over channel dimension.
Elementwise log(1 + x) on the result of step_001.
Output shape [512,256,256], dtype float32, CUDA tensor.
Final return of the log1p result.
